text: {"summary": "Cluster 'goat' scores 38.0 on NSA and 45.5 on MITRE (kubescape). The main risks are privileged hostPath workloads, default/Deployment/debug-shell and prod/DaemonSet/node-agent, and debug-shell also has an openssl HIGH CVE. The cluster-admin binding to system:masters looks like a platform default.
